A1.justification: Both complete, readable 12-page PDFs describe SelfRACG. Corresponding methods, equations, six tables, five figures, and Appendices A–E support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original code-completion and retrieval experiments, ablations, and retrieval-count analyses, including Figure 4 and the Qwen2.5-Coder results in Appendix E.

after.justification: v2 retains original code-completion and retrieval results, ablations, and appendix experiments in Tables 1–6 and Figure 4.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 retain the same INE module, parallel L-LoRA retrieval attention, layer averaging, two-stage ING training, contrastive objective, and MIPS inference. No procedural or architectural change is reported.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same GitHub-derived and synthetic training data and evaluate RepoEval API, line, and function completion plus CrossCodeEval. The newly cited supervised datasets are explicitly described as unused, so they do not expand coverage.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same no-retrieval, BM25, OpenAI-small/large, GritLM-7B, and NV-Embed-v2 entries. Table 3 retains the next-fragment and next-query alternatives. Newly cited retrieval methods are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Model variants, data filtering, 20-line segmentation, training sample counts, retrieval evaluation, and generation/retrieval metrics remain unchanged. Section 4.4's added statement about unused supervised datasets clarifies the existing setup rather than revising a previously stated setting.

E4.justification: The alternative retrieval strategies in Section 5.3, Stage 2 and L-LoRA ablations in Section 5.4, and fragment-count sensitivity analysis in Appendix C are unchanged. No additional analysis is introduced.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting. Neither reports experiment-level repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or statistical significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1–6 and Figure 4 retain the same numerical results and trends. For example, SelfRACG's OpenCoder-8B mean EM/ES remain 0.281/0.593 in Table 1, and its Qwen2.5-Coder-3B mean EM/ES remain 0.261/0.569 in Table 6.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(7) retain the same attention, low-rank adaptation, retrieval representation, averaging, and contrastive-loss definitions. Reflow changes their placement but not their mathematical content; no new proofs or formal assumptions appear.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about self-expressed information needs, preserved generation capabilities, improved retrieval/code generation, and reduced retrieval costs.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning preference alignment, implicit queries, batch-size constraints, and retrieval ranking remain unchanged. Appendix A retains the same limitations: evaluation only on RACG and models up to 8B parameters.

D1.justification: Section 4.4 newly states explicitly that no supervised training datasets were used, supplementing the existing GitHub-derived and synthetic-data descriptions. Hyperparameters, hardware, training-time disclosures, prompt template, and code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 4.4 adds five cited works: T2Ranking, MS MARCO, Qilin, I3 Retriever, and SAILER. These contextualize the distinction from supervised embedding-model training; the broader related-work discussion and novelty positioning remain stable.

P1.justification: v2 adds a short training-data clarification and an Acknowledgments section, and updates affiliations to include Quan Cheng Laboratory. The main narrative, section ordering, and appendix organization are otherwise retained.

P2.justification: The same figures and tables retain their content and structure. Figure 5 moves from page 11 to page 12 above Table 6, while additional references cause appendix reflow and equation/text placement shifts elsewhere.

improvement.justification: Section 4.4 makes explicit the absence of supervised training datasets, already consistent with v1's unsupervised GitHub and synthetic-data descriptions. The added citations, affiliations, acknowledgments, and layout adjustments provide limited clarification without materially strengthening or weakening the unchanged methods, empirical support, or limitations.
